integrity_statement: Analytical proof of exact joint distributions and weak limits; deterministic standard-library checker is only corroborating finite evidence. Priority versus unindexed general renewal-excursion theory is unresolved.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional zero-drift Brownian motion; independent instantaneous Poisson resets to the initial point; fixed positive diffusion, rate and target distance except for the explicitly stated low-rate crossover. No finite-sample statistical guarantees or non-Poisson extension.
title: Dual conditional extreme laws for a Brownian search with Poisson resets
